description: Pairwise-relational V4-invariant encoder + hybrid structured spectral decoder (learned low-rank basis head plus a FiLM-conditioned 1-D transposed-convolution decoder with a sub-pixel output head). Improve step of r00_draft3_symconv: only the encoder changes (the orbit-averaged 14-input MLP is replaced). Encoder: each resonator i becomes a token [rx_i, ry_i, theta_i, h, p] embedded by one shared MLP phi (Linear-GELU, 2 pre-LN residual GELU blocks, LayerNorm) -> u_i; for each of the three pair partitions that the sub-cell translations V4 = {e, (12)(34), (13)(24), (14)(23)} preserve ({12|34}, {13
model_repr:
RelConvNet(
  (enc): RelationalEncoder(
    (tok_in): Linear(in_features=5, out_features=256, bias=True)
    (tok_blocks): ModuleList(
      (0-1): 2 x ResMLP(
        (norm): LayerNorm((256,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
        (fc1): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=512, bias=True)
        (fc2): Linear(in_features=512, out_features=256, bias=True)
      )
    )
    (tok_norm): LayerNorm((256,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
    (pair_in): Linear(in_features=512, out_features=256, bias=True)
    (pair_blocks): ModuleList(
      (0): ResMLP(
        (norm): LayerNorm((256,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
        (fc1): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=512, bias=True)
        (fc2): Linear(in_features=512, out_features=256, bias=True)
      )
    )
    (pair_norm): LayerNorm((256,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
    (rho_in): Linear(in_features=1026, out_features=512, bias=True)
    (blocks): ModuleList(
      (0-1): 2 x ResMLP(
        (norm): LayerNorm((512,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
        (fc1): Linear(in_features=512, out_features=1024, bias=True)
        (fc2): Linear(in_features=1024, out_features=512, bias=True)
      )
    )
    (norm): LayerNorm((512,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
  )
  (coef): Linear(in_features=512, out_features=64, bias=True)
  (basis): Linear(in_features=64, out_features=2001, bias=True)
  (dec): ConvSpectralDecoder(
    (seed): Linear(in_features=512, out_features=4096, bias=True)
    (block0): ConvRes(
      (norm): GroupNorm(1, 128, eps=1e-05, affine=True)
      (c1): Conv1d(128, 128, kernel_size=(5,), stride=(1,), padding=(2,))
      (c2): Conv1d(128, 128, kernel_size=(5,), stride=(1,), padding=(2,))
    )
    (stages): ModuleList(
      (0): UpStage(
        (up): ConvTranspose1d(128, 96, kernel_size=(4,), stride=(2,), padding=(1,))
        (film): Linear(in_features=512, out_features=192, bias=True)
        (res): ConvRes(
          (norm): GroupNorm(1, 96, eps=1e-05, affine=True)
          (c1): Conv1d(96, 96, kernel_size=(5,), stride=(1,), padding=(2,))
          (c2): Conv1d(96, 96, kernel_size=(5,), stride=(1,), padding=(2,))
        )
      )
      (1): UpStage(
        (up): ConvTranspose1d(96, 64, kernel_size=(4,), stride=(2,), padding=(1,))
        (film): Linear(in_features=512, out_features=128, bias=True)
        (res): ConvRes(
          (norm): GroupNorm(1, 64, eps=1e-05, affine=True)
          (c1): Conv1d(64, 64, kernel_size=(5,), stride=(1,), padding=(2,))
          (c2): Conv1d(64, 64, kernel_size=(5,), stride=(1,), padding=(2,))
        )
      )
      (2): UpStage(
        (up): ConvTranspose1d(64, 64, kernel_size=(4,), stride=(2,), padding=(1,))
        (film): Linear(in_features=512, out_features=128, bias=True)
        (res): ConvRes(
          (norm): GroupNorm(1, 64, eps=1e-05, affine=True)
          (c1): Conv1d(64, 64, kernel_size=(5,), stride=(1,), padding=(2,))
          (c2): Conv1d(64, 64, kernel_size=(5,), stride=(1,), padding=(2,))
        )
      )
    )
    (norm): GroupNorm(1, 64, eps=1e-05, affine=True)
    (out): Conv1d(64, 8, kernel_size=(5,), stride=(1,), padding=(2,))
  )
)
